claim: The newsroom's public note on the sign-in is dated 6 November 2026.
The source note was read on 7 November 2026.
The conductor agent's tool makes two keys for each person: one for sealing things to them and one for their browser to sign with.
The conductor keeps a copy of each private key it issues, so it could read what is sealed to that person.
The observability page opens the vault keys sealed to Dinis Cruz.
The sign-in link carries the key after a '#' sign, and that part of a link never reaches a server.
The page clears the key from the address bar at once after opening the link.
The page checks the browser's signature of a fresh random challenge against the published public half of the key.
The note lists five ways to sign in: scan with a phone, scan with the computer's camera, choose a picture, paste or drop the image onto the page, and paste the link.
The sign-in note's diagram shows six steps from a key issued by the conductor to 'signed in'.
The sign-in diagram was made by journalist-ai@PrompTugal.vicky.
The sign-in link's private halves are saved as a QR code outside the repository and given only to that person by the conductor.
